product.title: Product
product.description: Managing a small business today is already tough.

hero.title: Install custom ship
hero.subtitle: Full-stack SaaS boilerplate. Next.js · React · better-auth. Auth, billing, teams, email, jobs - every wire already run.

featuresGrid.title: Built on what works
featuresGrid.subtitle: The pieces are picked, wired, and tested. Swap any of them, but you won't need to on day one.

features.title: Next.js 16 + App Router
features.description: Server Components, Server Actions, async params, route groups. The new model, used the right way.

features.title: Postgres + Prisma
features.description: Schema-first models, typed client, migrations checked in. Neon-ready for serverless deploys.

features.title: Turborepo + pnpm
features.description: Tuned task graph with remote cache. Apps and packages share types across the whole monorepo.

features.title: TypeScript end-to-end
features.description: Strict mode everywhere, Zod for boundaries, inferred types from Prisma to the form field.

features.title: shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4
features.description: Themeable primitives, dark mode, design tokens. Storybook included so designers can review live.

features.title: i18n + edge proxy
features.description: Locale-prefixed routes, message catalogs, CSP nonces. Production middleware patterns, not toys.

items.title: Orgs and personal accounts
items.description: Every user gets a personal workspace and can join any number of organizations. Billing, members, roles, and invites are scoped per-org — no leaks, no foot-guns.
bullets: Org-scoped subscriptions with one Stripe customer per org
Owner / admin / member roles with route-level guards
Invite flows with email confirmation and seat handling
Slug-based URLs validated at the proxy layer

items.title: Auth flows you'll ever need
items.description: Better Auth handles cryptography, sessions, and account lifecycle. You just plug providers in. Email, magic links, OAuth, OTP, and 2FA — already tested end-to-end.
bullets: Email + password with verification and recovery flows
Magic link sign-in and one-time code fallback
Google and GitHub OAuth out of the box
TOTP-based 2FA with backup codes and recovery

items.title: Stripe, wired the right way
items.description: Subscriptions per organization, prorated upgrades, verified webhooks, customer portal for cards and invoices. Plans declared in one config, surfaced in pricing and checkout.
bullets: Per-org customer with subscription scoping and seat limits
Self-serve portal for cards, invoices, and cancellation
Idempotent webhook handling with replay-safe events
Tiered plans (free / pro / enterprise) in one config file

items.title: Production security from day one
items.description: Edge protection, content security policy, rate limits, and audit trails. The hard parts of running a real product — already done, already tuned.
bullets: Per-request CSP nonces set by the edge proxy
Rate-limited sign-in attempts to deter brute force
Audit-ready session and account event tracking
Strict TypeScript and Zod validation at every boundary

pricing.title: Your price here
pricing.subtitle: One source, three tiers. Start free, upgrade when you outgrow it.

cta.title: Ready to ship your product?
cta.subtitle: Get the full kit and ship in a week, not a month.

footer.description: A SaaS boilerplate for people who ship.
